notes: Second pass by an independent verifier, 12 searches (shared with sglt2-inhibitors, which used the same retrievals). Summaries blend pages, so NHS-page attributions are by title. The "999" route for DKA and allergy is the site signposting rule; the retrieved NHS leaflet text says doctor or NHS 111 (DKA) and emergency help (Fournier). NICE TA775 is flagged by NICE as under review. Alcohol: NHS common-questions text also mentions unit limits, not used. Frequency of DKA differs between sources so "rare" was dropped. The 24-hour and 48-hour figures are source statements, not cut-offs for individual instruction. Lithium monitoring is from NHS England leaflet and emc SmPC (both seen only via search summary).
